interaction.bounded_pair_rule: Pair phone-rest features with low-mobility GPS features and phone/wearable-active or discordance features with context/mobility GPS features.

temporal_metadata.temporal_rule: Per-subject lag1, previous-3-row mean, and current-minus-previous-3-row deviation.

processed_source.source_note: Uses existing processed df_train_raw columns derived from phone/watch sensors around sleep_date; no new feature matrix is materialized.

solar_source.feature_source: Date-derived Seoul/Korea photoperiod approximation plus fixed 2024 Korean public-holiday proximity. No raw sensor payloads, processed sleep columns, labels, public scores, or candidate predictions are used to create features.
